items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Wilbur' only when the interviewer corrects the name of one of the pilots ('Orville' vs 'Wilbur'). The interviewee does not express any personal relationship with Wilbur, only acknowledging the correction.

ctx.x: Yes. Well, that’s what did it, so I could say I was a war bride. And we weren’t ready to get married prior to that. We were just enjoying each other, listening to jazz. That’s all we did. And he was recording people. Sidney Bechet! I mean, I met Sidney Bechet through Alfred, who was Alfred’s good friend. Alfred adored him. I adored him. All the women adored Sidney. He was a beautiful, wonderful guy, in spite of what other people say... I’ve read some things. But yeah...so...yeah... He got drafted into the Army,…
That was some trip. I was a mess. I’ll tell you. But I pulled myself together, and we got married. Again, that’s three times we got married.
